runtime_profile.notes: Node.js 20+ project using npm. Test infrastructure is Jest with ESM modules. Requires git-lfs for test model downloads. npm install uses --ignore-scripts to skip onnxruntime-node postinstall script that downloads GPU binary from GitHub and causes ConnectTimeoutError. CPU-only inference is supported via onnxruntime-web's WASM fallback.

notes: Transformers.js project requires Node.js 18+. Using node:20-bookworm as base image. git, curl, and git-lfs are included in system packages. The project uses ESM modules (type: module in package.json) and Jest for testing. Fixed runtime_setup_failure by using --ignore-scripts flag during npm install to skip the onnxruntime-node postinstall script that downloads GPU binaries from GitHub. CPU-only inference is sufficient for tests and is handled by onnxruntime-web's WASM fallback.
